out.detail: Had core muscle surgery, expected to be out three months; placed on long-term injured reserve Oct. 1

home.summary: The Dallas Stars are projected to start Jake Oettinger in goal, who has been strong recently with a 0.74 GAA and .963 save percentage over four appearances. The team is without Matt Duchene due to core surgery, leaving them averaging just 2.20 goals per game (27th in NHL) and struggling on the power play (28th at 7.7%). Despite offensive struggles, the Stars have allowed only one goal in their last three games, showing defensive resilience.
